title: BMDM Salmonella Replication
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gcrbsv6

steps.title: Prepare overnight Salmonella culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 ml of TSB with a single colony of *Salmonella Typhimurium* and incubate on a shaking wheel at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Harvest and plate BMDM
steps.instruction: Collect bone‑marrow‑derived macrophages (BMDM) with a cell scraper, transfer from one Petri dish to a 50‑ml tube, centrifuge 10 min at 1200 RPM, discard supernatant, resuspend cells using a 3‑ml syringe (start with a 20–21 G needle, finish with a 25 G needle) in 2 ml RPMI + 10 % FCS, count cells with a Coulter Counter or a 1/5 dilution with Turks (1.5 ml acetic acid, 48.5 ml ddH₂O, trace Gentamicin‑Violet), adjust to 1 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹ with fresh medium, aliquot 500 µl (5 × 10⁵ cells) per well of a 24‑well plate, 3 ml (3 × 10⁶ cells) per well of a 6‑well plate, and 100 µl per well of a 96‑well plate, then incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ (all LDH samples in triplicate).

steps.title: Prepare fresh Salmonella inoculum
steps.instruction: Inoculate 50 ml of TSB with 2 ml of the overnight culture, grow at 37 °C with agitation until OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.9 (≈90–120 min), place the culture on ice and readjust OD₆₀₀ to 0.9 if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial suspension for infection
steps.instruction: Aliquot two 1‑ml samples of the bacterial culture (≈5 × 10⁸ bacteria each) into Eppendorf tubes, centrifuge in a cold room 3–4 min at 13 000 RPM, discard supernatant and resuspend each pellet in 1 ml of saline, PBS, or RPMI without FCS.

steps.title: Replace BMDM medium
steps.instruction: Verify BMDM health microscopically, remove existing medium and add RPMI + 10 % FCS to each well.

steps.title: Add bacteria and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add the washed bacterial suspension to each well (see volumes below), then centrifuge plates at 500 g for 5 min at 25 °C:

substeps.instruction: 6‑well plate: 3 ml RPMI + 10 % FCS + 60 µl bacteria (prepare 20 ml medium + 400 µl washed bacteria).
24‑well plate: 500 µl RPMI + 10 % FCS + 10 µl bacteria (prepare 15 ml medium + 300 µl washed bacteria).
96‑well plate: 100 µl RPMI + 10 % FCS + 2 µl bacteria (prepare 10 ml medium + 200 µl washed bacteria).
Note: 10 µl bacteria ≈5 × 10⁶ bacteria, giving an MOI of 10 bacteria cell⁻¹.

steps.title: Incubate infected BMDM (45 min)
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates 45 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Plate serial dilutions of infectious dose
steps.instruction: During the 45‑min incubation, plate 100 µl of the infectious dose at 10⁻³, 10⁻⁴ and 10⁻⁵ dilutions onto TSB agar plates.

steps.title: Wash cells post‑incubation
steps.instruction: After incubation, discard supernatant and wash cells twice with pre‑heated (37 °C) PBS:

substeps.instruction: 24‑well plate: 500 µl per wash.
6‑well plate: appropriate volume (ml) per wash (as used for 6‑well).
96‑well plate: 100 µl per wash.

steps.title: Add gentamicin‑containing medium (LDH start)
steps.instruction: Add pre‑heated (37 °C) RPMI + 10 % FCS without phenol red containing 100 µg ml⁻¹ gentamicin:

substeps.instruction: 24‑well plate: 500 µl (prepare 15 ml medium + 150 µl gentamicin 10 mg ml⁻¹).
6‑well plate: 2 ml (prepare 20 ml medium + 200 µl gentamicin 10 mg ml⁻¹).
96‑well plate: appropriate volume (as used for 96‑well) (prepare 15 ml medium + 150 µl gentamicin 10 mg ml⁻¹).
Include an extra triplicate well containing medium only.

steps.title: Collect LDH and cytokine samples
steps.instruction: Start the timer (time 0 = addition of gentamicin). For each scheduled time point:

substeps.instruction: Spin the plate at 250 g for 4 min on ice.
Transfer 50 µl supernatant to an LDH assay plate (keep on ice).
Transfer another 50 µl supernatant to a tube for ELISA cytokine measurement.
Lyse cells by adding 100 µl PBS + 1 % Triton X‑100, mix, and transfer lysate to a 2‑ml push‑cap tube for plating.
Dilute 50 µl of the lysate in 450 µl PBS‑Triton to obtain 10⁻¹ and 10⁻² dilutions (for CFU calculation: CFU = CFU/100 µl × 500 × dilution).
Incubate infected cells 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Discard supernatant, wash twice with pre‑heated PBS (500 µl for 24‑well; appropriate volume for 6‑well).
Add RPMI + 10 % FCS pre‑heated at 37 °C containing 10 µg ml⁻¹ gentamicin:
24‑well: 500 µl (prepare 15 ml medium + 15 µl gentamicin 10 mg ml⁻¹).
6‑well: 2 ml (prepare 20 ml medium + 20 µl gentamicin 10 mg ml⁻¹).
Define this addition as time 0.
Continue incubation for 1, 2 and 4 h.
At each time point, collect supernatant for cytokine ELISA and freeze at –80 °C.
Lyse cells with 500 µl PBS + 1 % Triton X‑100, transfer lysate to a 4‑ml push‑cap tube.

steps.title: Plate lysate dilutions and incubate
steps.instruction: Dilute each lysate 10⁻¹ to 10⁻³, spread 100 µl of the 10⁻² and 10⁻³ dilutions onto TSB agar plates, and incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Count CFUs next day
steps.instruction: Count colonies, accounting for plated volume and dilution using the formula: CFU = (CFUs per 100 µl) × 500 × dilution = CFUs per well.
